system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
## REVIEW OF SELLER’S UPDATED SPA & DISCLOSURE LETTER  
**Project Kestrel – Wattlebridge Holdings (Buyer) vs Harbourglass Ventures (Seller)**  

---

### EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
The Seller’s “fair and balanced” package is **materially misaligned** with the Buyer’s playbook on **every core protection**: liability cap, thresholds, claim periods, fundamental warranties, fraud carve-out, disclosure standard, buyer-knowledge qualifier, Bluefen consent, Riverlark discharge, employee bonuses, Ironquay IP, title evidence, and the treatment of tax/IP warranties. The Disclosure Letter confirms most of the key due-diligence items remain **unresolved** (Bluefen consent, Riverlark payout, Ironquay payment, bonus funding, export investigation, Sandbar classification, title verification).  

**Bottom line:** This draft is not a negotiating baseline—it is a Seller-favourable framework that would lock in inferior terms unless every point below is pushed back.

---

## 1. GENERAL WARRANTY CAP – CLAUSE 12.1
| Playbook | Seller Draft | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| **25% / AUD 6 M** (starting position). 20% / AUD 4.8 M only with **Amelia Frost written authority** (none given). | 20% / AUD 4.8 M flat. | **Unapproved fallback.** The 20% cap is a conditional concession; no authority exists. Must hold at 25% / AUD 6 M. |

---

## 2. THRESHOLDS – CLAUSE 12.2
| Playbook | Seller Draft | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| **De minimis AUD 5 k**; **basket AUD 50 k** (first-dollar recovery once exceeded). | De minimis **AUD 25 k**; basket **AUD 250 k** (deductible/excess-only). | **5× wider on both thresholds** and a **deductible basket** (Seller pays only excess). This eliminates recovery for small/medium claims. Push to playbook numbers and first-dollar basket. |

---

## 3. GENERAL CLAIMS PERIOD – CLAUSES 12.3 / 13
| Playbook | Seller Draft | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| **24 months** post-Completion. 18 months only with **Amelia Frost written approval** (none). | **18 months**. | **Unapproved fallback.** Insist on 24 months. |

---

## 4. FUNDAMENTAL / TITLE WARRANTIES
| Playbook | Seller Draft | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| **Separate regime**: 100% cap, **≥ 6 years**, **outside** general basket/de minimis/knowledge bar. | **Same caps, time limits, baskets as general warranties** (“administrative simplicity”). | **Total collapse of fundamental protections.** Title/capacity claims would be capped at AUD 4.8 M, barred after 18 months, subject to AUD 250 k basket and buyer-knowledge bar. **Non-negotiable: separate regime must be reinstated.** |

---

## 5. FRAUD / WILFUL CONCEALMENT / DELIBERATE MISCONDUCT
| Playbook | Seller Draft | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| **Carved out of ALL caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance**—to maximum enforceable extent. No waiver permitted. | **Limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance apply to “all Claims of any nature”** (Cl 9.3/12.8/20.5). | **Fraud explicitly included in limitations.** This is a **deal-breaker**. Must insert an unqualified fraud/wilful misconduct carve-out that survives any “entire agreement” or non-reliance clause. |

---

## 6. DISCLOSURE STANDARD – SCHEDULE 7 / DISCLOSURE LETTER
| Playbook | Seller Draft | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| **Specific fair disclosure** only. Reject whole-data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure. | **General disclosure** of entire data room (DD-002 to DD-012), statutory registers, **public registers** (Disclosure Letter §§1.1–1.2). | **Impermissible blanket disclosure.** Data-room dump + public registers does not satisfy “fair disclosure.” Require **specific, document-by-document disclosure** with page/paragraph references; delete general disclosure clauses. |

---

## 7. BUYER KNOWLEDGE – CLAUSE 8.3
| Playbook | Seller Draft | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| **Delete blanket buyer-knowledge exclusions**. Any qualifier: named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry. **Never excuses title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity.** | **Blanket bar**: “no claim… of which the Buyer or its advisers had knowledge, **including any matter discoverable from the data room or public records**.” | **“Discoverable” standard is objectively impossible** (charges Buyer with constructive knowledge of entire data room + public records). Also swallows title, capacity, fraud, indemnities. **Must delete or narrow to actual knowledge of named Buyer individuals after reasonable enquiry; carve out fundamental warranties, fraud, specific indemnities.** |

---

## 8. BLUEFEN CONSENT – CLAUSES 3 / 6.3
| Playbook | Seller Draft | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| **Effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied** pre-Completion. Not consent-on-delivery. **Reasonable endeavours insufficient** for material customer. | **Reasonable endeavours only**; consent “satisfied on delivery of counterparty’s written consent.” | **No condition-satisfaction evidence; consent-on-delivery; mere endeavours.** Disclosure Letter §2 confirms **no final written consent, no evidence conditions satisfied**. **Require:** (a) executed consent **before** Completion, (b) documentary proof all clause 11.3 conditions met, (c) condition precedent to Completion, not post-Completion undertaking. |

---

## 9. RIVERLARK FACILITY – CLAUSES 2 / 7
| Playbook | Seller Draft | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| **Current payout from Completion funds + effective security releases** at Completion. Post-Completion release only with **irrevocable undertaking + Amelia Frost approval**. | **Release “following Completion”** (post-Completion).
